title: Armarium Reference record
description: A completed record (including permitted stubs) as JSON-compatible parsed frontmatter and Markdown body.

subtype.description: Optional. Style for an illustration style. Membership requires a separate vault-aware check.

illustrates.description: The record kinds the style applies to, each a type or Type/Subtype, such as Content/Gear.

directory.description: The folder inside assets/ that the style's art goes in.

opacity.description: Whether the style's art is a drawing on white stored as black opacity on a transparent ground.

max_bytes.description: The largest art file allowed, in bytes.

max_edge.description: The largest long edge allowed, in pixels.

references.description: Links to images that show the style, or to records whose image does.

sample.description: How many references to send with each candidate, drawn at random.

wikilink.description: Canonical internal wikilink without an alias or anchor. Existence and target kind must be checked separately.
